sections.text_helper: Section 72.5 "Debug signals" in chapter 72 (USB subsystem (USBSS)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3759.
sections.section_content:
Signals of the OTG high-speed Port 1 and Port 2 are multiplexed and routed to the
hardware debug port (HDP). The SELOTGDBG bit in OTG2PHYCTL_CR register controls
the multiplexer. These debug signals are tapped on the UTMI+ interface between the OTG
controller (OTG1, OTG2) and the USB2 PHYs (OTGPHY1, OTGPHY2). The list of debug
signals is described in the Hardware Debug Port User Specifications (table 3).
[Figure 981. Multiplexing of debug signals in the USB subsystem]
